title: San Francisco's Century of Street Cars
author: Fred A. Stindt
description: San Francisco's Century of Street Cars" by Fred Astin and Judah Fettott provides comprehensive historical insight into San Francisco’s streetcar systems over a century long period, featuring detailed information on various routes, including the Market Street Railway operated by United Railroads, as well as the roster and history of numerous electric street cars. This informative guide is essential for transportation enthusiasts and historians alike.
